# Direct third-party dependencies warren is allowed to declare.
#
# One crate per line: crate name, the workspace crates allowed to depend on it
# (comma-separated, or * for any), then the reason it is here. Every entry must
# be in use, declared once in [workspace.dependencies] with an exact `=`
# version, vendored, and covered by cargo-vet. scripts/check-deps.sh enforces
# this list; docs/dependencies.md explains how to add a crate.
#
# crate             users                                                                                                      purpose
aws-lc-rs           warren-control,warren-core,warren-harness                                                                  the one crypto provider: signatures, digests, AEAD for keys at rest, randomness; node key generation and signing (join requests, test PKI)
base64              warren-control,warren-core                                                                                 base64 and base64url for JOSE objects, PEM and tokens
bytes               warren-client,warren-connector,warren-control,warren-core,warren-harness,warren-masque                     shared byte buffers for packets, capsules, frames and hyper bodies; already required by quinn and h2
cedar-policy        warren-policy                                                                                              the policy engine: parse, validate and evaluate compiled Cedar policy
clap                warren,warren-harness                                                                                      command-line parsing (builder API only: no derive, no color)
form_urlencoded     warren-control                                                                                             query strings and form bodies in the OIDC flow
h2                  warren-masque                                                                                              HTTP/2 with extended CONNECT (RFC 8441) for the TCP 443 fallback carrier
http                warren-control,warren-masque                                                                               HTTP request and response types shared by h2 and hyper
http-body           warren-control                                                                                             the body trait for the streaming revocation event response
http-body-util      warren-control                                                                                             fixed and size-limited request and response bodies
hyper               warren-control                                                                                             HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 server and client for the control-plane API and IdP calls
hyper-util          warren-control                                                                                             tokio glue and the HTTP/1.1-or-HTTP/2 server builder for hyper
libc                warren-core                                                                                                the TUN device's open, ioctl, read and write on Linux
quinn               warren-client,warren-connector,warren-core,warren-masque,warren-relay                                      QUIC (RFC 9000, RFC 9221 datagrams, DPLPMTUD) on tokio with rustls
rustls              warren,warren-client,warren-connector,warren-control,warren-core,warren-harness,warren-masque,warren-relay TLS 1.3 on aws-lc-rs, warren's only TLS stack
rustls-native-certs warren-control                                                                                             the operating system's trust store for calls to a public IdP
rustls-webpki       warren-core,warren-masque                                                                                  certificate path verification against the deployment trust bundle
saphyr-parser       warren-policy                                                                                              YAML parsing with line numbers for the policy surface (compiler feature only)
serde               warren-control,warren-core                                                                                 serialization of wire types (bundles, events, API bodies)
serde_json          warren-control,warren-core,warren-harness,warren-masque,warren-policy                                      JSON for the APIs, bundles, Cedar entities, the join exchange and OCSF-shaped audit records
sqlx                warren-control                                                                                             the one SQL layer: SQLite embedded now, PostgreSQL later, one migration set
tokio               warren,warren-client,warren-connector,warren-control,warren-core,warren-harness,warren-masque,warren-relay async runtime, sockets, timers and signals
tokio-rustls        warren-control,warren-masque                                                                               rustls over tokio sockets (control-plane listener, HTTP/2 fallback)
tracing             warren,warren-client,warren-connector,warren-core,warren-masque,warren-relay                               structured logging; quinn and h2 log through it as well
tracing-subscriber  warren-core                                                                                                JSON-lines log output on stderr
zeroize             warren-control,warren-core                                                                                 wiping private keys and secrets from memory after use
